title: Redstrike Signal Vocabulary
description: The CLOSED vocabulary of recon routing signals and the shape of a signals.json feeder document. A signal is a `family:token` fact recon emits (param:injectable, sink:dom, asset:cloud, ...); the deterministic coverage plan routes vuln categories off these. This schema is the single enumerated source of the vocabulary used to VALIDATE coordination artifacts at ingest — the re-convergence inbox (reconvergence/inbox.jsonl), coverage_ledger.signals_used, and the signals feeder output — so an out-of-vocab token (a typo or invented signal) is rejected instead of silently folded in, where it routes to nothing and masks a recall gap. It MUST stay identical to routing-map.json's `signals` block; scripts/validate.py fails on any drift in either direction.

signals.description: the recon signals present for this engagement; each MUST be in the vocabulary.

signal_evidence.description: optional per-signal evidence map the feeder may attach.

signal.description: a recon routing signal, one of the closed vocabulary (identical to routing-map.json signals).
